name: What are common home modifications recommended after a senior safety assessment?

mainEntity.name: What are common home modifications recommended after a senior safety assessment?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common modifications recommended after a senior safety assessment include installing grab bars in bathrooms, adding raised toilet seats, and converting tubs to walk-in showers. For general mobility, recommendations often feature wider doorways, ramp installations for entryways, and improved lighting throughout the home, especially in hallways and stairwells. Other suggestions might involve non-slip flooring, lever-style door handles, easy-to-reach controls for appliances, and smart home technology for convenience and security. These changes aim to reduce fall risks and enhance daily living.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common modifications include grab bars, walk-in showers, ramps, improved lighting, and non-slip flooring to reduce fall risks and enhance accessibility.
